question: In which water body do several Himalayan tributaries like Shyok, Gilgit, Shigar, Gasting and Dras meet and finally emerge from the hills near Attock where it receives the Kabul River?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Indus River System.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indus receives a number of Himalayan tributaries. 
 
• The Indus finally emerges out of the hills near Attock where Kabul river on its right bank.
 
• The Indus River is called as **"Nile of Pakistan".**
 
• It is also known as the **"Father of Rivers"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The major Himalayan rivers are:**__

 __
 
• **​**__**Indus.**
 
• **Jhelum.**
 
• **Chenab.**
 
• **Beas.**
 
• **Ravi.**
 
• **Saraswati.**
 
• **Sutlej.**
 
• **Ganga (or the Ganges).**
 
• **The Yamuna.**
 
• **The Brahmaputra**.
